|affiliation = Dragonsworn}}'''Renald Fanwar''' is a farmer living in the [[Borderlands]].

== History ==
He lived and worked on his farm for forty years. He is married to [[Auaine Fanwar|Auaine]], and they have sons that have moved away from home to seek their own fortunes. He has six workers on his farm: [[Merk]], [[Favidan]], [[Rinnin]], [[Veshir]], [[Adamad]] and [[Geleni]].

== Activities ==
When [[Thulin]] stops by to tell Fanwar that he is headed north to help the armies fight in [[Tarmon Gai'don]], he decides to do the same. He gathers his wife and his farmhands and they all pack up their belongings to prepare to leave for the Last Battle.

Seen working on the palisade at the field of Merrilor with Mat in [[A Memory of Light]]. [[Almen Bunt]] is with him and calls him by name.
